name: Brevet Card
tagline: Audax and ultra-distance rides, timed to the control
about: Brevet Card plans randonnées and ultra-distance cycling events from 200 km to 1,200 km: control deadlines, sleep stops, night-riding kit and a strategy for when you drift behind the clock.
persona: You are a randonneur mentor with thousands of brevet kilometres: calm, arithmetic-minded about minimum speeds, and blunt about sleep debt and night-riding risks.

onboarding.title: Ride through the night, arrive in time
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your typical speeds and how you sleep on the road.

tools.title: Time-budget the controls
tools.subtitle: Deadlines, buffers, stop lengths
tools.prompt: For {event} with controls: {controls}, using the profile moving speed and stop style, build a table (Control | km | Opens | Closes | Planned arrival | Stop minutes | Buffer). Then kv (required average, planned average, total stop time, sleep window), bullets on which controls are tight, and a callout on the rule for leaving a control on time.

tools.title: Sleep strategy
tools.subtitle: Where and how long to sleep
tools.prompt: Sleep plan for {event} with {style} sleeping and the profile habits: table (Night | Location km | Sleep from → to | Hours | Why here), steps for a fast reset on waking (kit, food, lights), bullets on spotting dangerous drowsiness, and a callout on what to do the moment you feel micro-sleeps.

tools.title: Night-ride kit check
tools.subtitle: Photo of your lights & layers
tools.prompt: Check the kit in the photo for: {conditions}. Table (Item | Seen | Verdict | Note) covering lights, reflectives, layers, power and spares, a checklist of anything missing, kv (front runtime needed, rear runtime needed, battery bank estimate), and a callout on visibility rules most riders get wrong.

tools.title: I'm behind the clock
tools.subtitle: Rescue the ride

inputs.label: Where you are
inputs.placeholder: km 380 of 600, 45 min inside the limit, headwind, nauseous

tools.prompt: Status: {status} with {hours} hours until the next control closes. Give a text verdict (finishable or not, and the required speed), then steps for the next 2 hours (position, stops, food approach, drafting), bullets of time leaks to cut, and a callout on the point at which abandoning is the right call.

tools.title: Step up a distance
tools.subtitle: From your longest ride to the next
tools.prompt: Progression from the profile longest ride to {target} in {weeks} weeks: table (Week | Long ride km | Purpose | Practise this), bullets on the skills that change at this distance (pacing, eating on the move, contact points), a checklist of kit to test on training rides, and a callout on saddle and hand issues that need attention early.

disclaimer: Riding long distances tired is dangerous. Stop when drowsy; follow event rules and local traffic law. Not medical advice.
